At an introduced installed minimum leg stiffness of 13 MN/m, this gives 0.10036 J. Summing independently maximized leg energies would give 0.35535 J, although those leg maxima cannot occur simultaneously.

Including clearance work, keeper allowance, bearing play, thermal movement, a bounded additional energy stock and permanent-set allowance gives:

Represented mode	Conditional translation bound	Result
Selected cut open; drive positively locked	0.98746 mm	Numerically below 1 mm
Cuts closed; drive moving and then caught	0.64369 mm	Numerically below 1 mm
Open cut and drive coast allowed together	1.04668 mm	Fails
Thirty-six undamped dynamic samples	Maximum 0.62058 mm	Samples only

The first case gives a rotation bound of 0.1547° and a leg-force screen up to approximately 8.45 kN.

The 13 μm apparent translation margin is not a usable manufacturing margin. It depends on premises that the installed machine has not established.
